prompt:
Extract a SysML v2 model from the document as a list of facts. Each fact has unit_id (the sentence it comes from), type and slots. Give only the slots that have a value, as a list of {slot, value} pairs; for composition give one 'parts' pair per part.

Types and slots:
  attribute(owner,name,value,unit) action(performer,label) state(owner,label) constraint(subject,expression) requirement(subject,text)
  composition(whole,parts) flow(source,target,payload) succession(before,after) transition(from,to,trigger) allocation(action,to)

Name each element by its full name as first introduced in the document.
RULES:
- Resolve every entity-valued slot using all the text you are given. If a sentence refers to an element by an alias, abbreviation, pronoun or shorter description, write the element's full name as first introduced. If a sentence says an element receives or uses an item and the text you are given states which element produces or sends that item, emit a flow from that producer to the receiver. If an element cannot be determined from the text you are given, use null; never guess.
- Never write placeholder words such as "any", "all", "some state" for an unstated element; use null.
- Do not merge differently named things unless the text says they are the same.
- Emit one action for EVERY behavior verb phrase, including passive voice (performer null), capability statements, displays, logs, generates and reports. label = the verbatim verb phrase with its object.
- Emit a requirement for every NORMATIVE statement (shall, must, should, will, is required to, needs to). Purpose, goal or benefit sentences are not requirements.
- Emit a state for every named mode or state; transitions use the state names, with from null when the prior state is not stated.
- Emit a succession only for an EXPLICIT temporal connective between two actions ("then", "after", "once", "before", "when ... is complete", "next", "finally"); before/after are the action labels. Never use succession for cause or data transfer.
- Resolve a pronoun or "this/these" performer to the element named in the preceding sentence and write that element's name; if it cannot be resolved, use null. Never output a pronoun as a slot value.
- Drop determiners and quantifiers from element names ("Each Soil Moisture Probe" -> "Soil Moisture Probe", "the system" -> "system").
- allocation.to must be a component or actor, never a mode or state.
- Emit a constraint for every threshold, limit, period or deadline stated with a number; expression = the verbatim phrase.
- Emit a flow for every sentence in which an element sends, transmits, reports, displays, commands or delivers an item (target null if the receiver is not named).
 Also list under "entities" every system element, actor or item named in the document units, with its full name and any alias the text explicitly declares for it (e.g. 'hereafter X', 'known as X', 'called X'); aliases [] if none. Return JSON {"entities": [...], "facts": [...]}.

Memory from EARLIER parts of the document (do not extract facts from it; use it only to resolve names, aliases and who produces an item):
Regional Dispatch Center (call sign Juniper) is continuous intake, triage-support, dispatch, and coordination under approved protocols; jurisdictions retain resource ownership/local-policy responsibility. Juniper creates incident records, preserves original reports with clarifications, maintains regional coverage picture from current unit locations, crew reports, and readiness, and escalates gaps. Call Taker Mara (Larkspur) confirms/repeats location before medical details, captures symptoms, hazards/access barriers, separates observed from reported facts, updates records before dispatch, and produces Caller Location Correction Slip. Computer Aided Dispatch Console checks address/map data and presents incident details, priority, travel times, availability, constraints, and staging options accounting for demand, travel, and access; verify currency. Triage Supervisor (Copperfield) reviews uncertain/conflicting/deteriorating/severe/escalation cases, directs focused clarification without delaying urgent response, assigns/documents priority by immediacy, time sensitivity, deterioration risk; immediate threats get highest available priority and prompt dispatch. Sends Pediatric Acuity Note; refers unusual cases to Regional Medical Director when time permits. Regional Medical Director sets policy/advises clinical resource needs, no dispatch authority. Data Quality Officer (Pebble) flags defects, cannot change priority, audits completeness/compliance/rationales, sends Duplicate Incident Audit Memo. Ambulance Coordination Platform consolidates unit position/status and presents suitable units; selection weighs confirmed priority, clinical need, travel, capability/readiness, constraints, coverage. Dispatcher records authorized unit, conditions, authorization time, and selection reason. Shift Commander (Sundial) approves coverage-reducing/nonstandard exceptions, handles conflicts/surge/continuity/readiness, reviews coverage before staging moves; not clinical authority. Radio Coordinator (Mistral) selects and confirms available talkgroup, checks reachability, transmits incident ID, location, priority, assignment, hazards; retries absent acknowledgment and alerts dispatch supervisor. Regional Radio Network carries route instructions/acknowledgments; Mistral confirms approved route changes before diversion. Paramedic Crew acknowledges and repeats location/priority; reports material route conflicts and patient changes; promptly reports unit status (available, responding, on scene, transporting, temporarily unavailable). Dispatch corrects discrepancies with fresh transmission. Handoff requires crew acknowledgment and dispatch-floor confirmation of essential details. North Gate Status Board and South Gate Status Board support changing access routing; state confirmed gate constraints and uncertainty explicitly. Crew stays at staging point until reassigned; Ambulance Unit 417 reports position/status entering/leaving staging. Bluejay verifies maintenance clearance
